Hermann and Dorothea

Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Goethe’s “
novelette in verse
” tells the story of a young girl who finds love after fleeing the chaos of the French Revolution. This work influenced many artists of the day, including Arthur Hugh Clough, whose 
The Bothie
 borrows heavily from this work. See 
Cambridge History of English and American Literature
.
